name: Strait of Malacca Port Approach Ambush
description: A fast interceptor USV on a port-approach transit is drawn off the fairway by an insidious sub-threshold GNSS walk-off, then threatened by an injected AIS phantom on a starboard crossing (COLREGS Rule 15), and finally has its throttle and rudder seized by an unauthorized C2 RC override near a navigational hazard.

stages.name: Normal Transit Underway
stages.narrative: Vessel transits the fairway under autopilot LOS guidance. Baseline telemetry established; all sensors nominal.

stages.name: Sub-Threshold GNSS Walk-off Spoofing
stages.narrative: Insidious low-rate pseudorange walk-off pulls the believed fix off the fairway, inducing the autopilot to steer the TRUE track toward shallows.

stages.name: AIS Phantom Collision Threat (Rule 15 Starboard Crossing)
stages.narrative: A phantom contact is injected on a starboard crossing course, forcing a COLREGS Rule 15 give-way decision against a target that does not physically exist.

stages.name: Unauthorized C2 RC Override Seizure
stages.narrative: An attacker replays/forges RC override frames, seizing throttle and rudder to drive the vessel hard-over toward the hazard.
